# Training Plan Creator Skill for Muse

Builds personalized race plans for 5K, 10K, half-marathon, and marathon: it interviews you about your running profile, calculates zone-based target paces with its bundled Python script, and lays out a phased, week-by-week progression grounded in a coach's-guide reference. The thinking is structured like a real coach's intake — current fitness, target race, weekly mileage — not a one-size template. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: paces default to miles (a `--per-km` option exists) — some US bias; and the Python pace script is optional, Muse can do the math by hand if you prefer. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
